text:
kevin: Hey team — quick heads up, noticed the curl example in runtime quickstart is returning 403 for new orgs when they hit the shortlink. It's at the top of the page, easy to miss in onboarding. Can someone claim?

Docs-bot: Automated scan flagged a 403 for https://rwd.in/quickstart-curl (first seen 1735559800). See run: https://internal.ci/runs/987

aj: I'll take a look, can repro locally. suspect the shortlink redirects to staging S3 with ACL issue.

maria: I opened a small PR (link: https://git.redwood/pr/1234) to swap the shortlink to the canonical runtime-example path — it's a 1-line change in docs. Needs a reviewer + merge window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tim: Is this blocking the public quickstart? We should prioritize if it's breaking signups.

sophie: Saw two signups hit this today during onboarding — it blocked the curl step. I'd vote for quick merge and cherry-pick to stable. :+1:

aj: Quick notes: repro steps
1) fresh account
2) paste curl sample into terminal
3) respond with 403 and HTML error

Snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://rwd.in/quickstart-curl \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```

aj: Root cause looks like the shortlink's origin bucket policy doesn't include allow for `public-read` on the new deploy target. I can prepare a config fix or we can swap link to long path.

maria: PR switches to long path to avoid bucket policy. Low-risk. I can update changelog and add a commit message referencing the incident.

tim: +1 to swap and then follow up with infra fix. Who can merge?

kevin: @aj can you review maria's PR? If green, merge and request a cherry-pick to stable branch. I'll notify onboarding flows that a fix is live.

aj: On it, reviewing now. ETA 20 mins. :watch:

deploy-bot: New deploy scheduled to staging at 1735560200 — will run smoke tests post-merge.

sophie: Thanks all — tagging @product-ops to pause any onboarding emails until fix is in prod. :white_check_mark:

aj: Merged and cherry-picked to stable `release/1.8` — smoke tests passed. Staging deploy queued.

kevin: Awesome — closing loop. Can we add a tiny note in the quickstart about shortlink flakiness and add an owner (docs) so we don't regress?

maria: Will add ownership frontmatter and a one-liner in the doc. PR link: https://git.redwood/pr/1235

kevin: Perfect. Thanks everyone. :tada:
